Radiant, addictive, and unmistakably refined, Fumeri 540 is a fragrance built around contrast — airy yet intense, delicate yet powerful. Inspired by the allure of modern niche perfumery, the scent opens with luminous saffron and jasmine before unfolding into warm amberwood and mineral ambergris. A smooth cedarwood base leaves behind a sensual trail that lingers beautifully on the skin.

Sophisticated and effortlessly unisex, Fumeri 540 is designed for those drawn to statement fragrances with quiet elegance and lasting presence.

Olfactive Notes
Top — Saffron, Jasmine
Heart — Amberwood, Ambergris
Base — Cedarwood, Fir Resin

Sophisticated, radiant, and effortlessly modern, Fumeri Adore is a unisex fragrance crafted for those who appreciate understated luxury. Fresh citrus accords open the composition with clarity and brightness, unfolding into a refined floral heart balanced by warm woods and sensual amber. Smooth musk and vanilla create a soft yet lasting finish that lingers elegantly on the skin.

Balanced between freshness and depth, Fumeri Adore is designed to be worn with confidence — timeless, versatile, and quietly distinctive.

Olfactive Notes
Top — Bergamot, Citrus Accord
Heart — White Florals, Soft Spices
Base — Amber, Sandalwood, Musk, Vanilla

Bold, indulgent, and irresistibly feminine, Fumeri Angel is a fragrance that balances sensual warmth with modern glamour. Rich gourmand notes unfold with sweetness and depth, softened by delicate florals and wrapped in warm vanilla and patchouli. The result is a fragrance that feels both seductive and sophisticated — lingering long after the first impression.

Decadent yet refined, Fumeri Angel is designed for evenings, special moments, and those who gravitate toward statement scents with lasting presence.

Olfactive Notes
Top — Bergamot, Red Fruits
Heart — Jasmine, Honey, Caramel
Base — Vanilla, Patchouli, Musk

Delicate yet undeniably addictive, Fumeri Flirt is a modern expression of effortless femininity. Bright notes of pink grapefruit and ripe peach unfold into a luminous floral heart, where peony and jasmine soften the composition with elegance and depth. As the fragrance settles, warm vanilla, sensual musk, and amber leave a smooth, intimate trail on the skin.

Refined, playful, and quietly seductive — Fumeri Flirt is designed for those drawn to understated luxury and lasting impressions.

Olfactive Notes

Heart — Peony, Jasmine, Orange Blossom
Base — Vanilla, Musk, Amber

Elegant, luminous, and effortlessly feminine, Fumeri Gabriella is a fragrance that captures quiet sophistication with a modern edge. The composition opens with sparkling mandarin and soft pink pepper, creating a fresh yet subtly sensual introduction. At its heart, delicate jasmine petals and creamy tuberose unfold with refined floral depth, before melting into a warm base of sandalwood, vanilla, and soft musk.

Graceful and memorable, Gabriella is designed for those who appreciate understated luxury and timeless beauty in every detail.

Olfactive Notes
Top — Mandarin, Pink Pepper
Heart — Jasmine Petals, Tuberose
Base — Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk

Elegant, modern, and effortlessly refined, Fumeri Rose Vetiver is a sophisticated interpretation of floral warmth balanced with earthy depth.
